# Plantpal — delivery brief

Client: Plantpal team, Example Inc.
App: Plantpal — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/plantpal/id0000000000
Account: example
Videos: ios, promo

## Narrative Conversion Framework

### Positioning
A made-up plant care app used only as a test fixture.

### Creative Rules
- No ratings, star counts, review totals or follower numbers on screen. Record around counters that display zeroes.
- No specific prices in either cut.
- Expert calls are Pro-tier and the tier is named in the same frame wherever they appear.
- No em dashes anywhere in the cuts.

## Apple App Store Preview (30s)

Narration, in order
1. Your plants are trying to tell you something.
2. Plantpal shows you every plant you own in one place.
3. Snap a leaf and an expert tells you what it needs.
4. Plantpal. Happy plants, finally.

Layout

Line 1
- Voice: Your plants are trying to tell you something.
- Visuals: A woman looking at a drooping fern on her windowsill. No device, no app UI.
- Featured Text: Listen to your plants

Line 2
- Voice: Plantpal shows you every plant you own in one place.
- Visuals: The Plantpal logo lands on the spoken name and hands off into the Garden screen: the "My jungle" header, the plant cards scrolling, then a tap into a plant profile showing the photo, watering schedule and notes. Follower counters framed out.
- Featured Text: Every plant, one place

Line 3
- Voice: Snap a leaf and an expert tells you what it needs.
- Visuals: The expert chat thread. A leaf photo is attached from the composer and sent, and a written reply from the named expert arrives with one fix.
- Featured Text: Ask an expert

Line 4
- Voice: Plantpal. Happy plants, finally.
- Visuals: Brand logo on the green brand field, tagline beneath.
- Featured Text: Happy plants, finally.

## Promo Video, paid social (45s)

Narration, in order
1. Every plant app shows you a care card.
2. Plantpal shows you every plant you own in one place.
3. Snap a leaf and an expert tells you what it needs.
4. Go Pro and book a video call with an expert.
5. Plantpal. Happy plants, finally.

Layout

Line 1
- Voice: Every plant app shows you a care card.
- Visuals: A man watering the wrong plant. Still no app UI.
- Featured Text: Generic care isn't care

Line 2
- Voice: Plantpal shows you every plant you own in one place.
- Visuals: The Garden screen: the "My jungle" header and the plant cards, held as the first app footage of the cut.
- Featured Text: Every plant, one place

Line 3
- Voice: Snap a leaf and an expert tells you what it needs.
- Visuals: The expert chat thread. A leaf photo is attached from the composer and sent, and a written reply from the named expert arrives with one fix.
- Featured Text: Ask an expert

Line 4
- Voice: Go Pro and book a video call with an expert.
- Visuals: The Book a Call screen with the call options listed, one selected. The Pro tier named in the same frame as the options.
- Featured Text: Experts on video, on Pro

Line 5
- Voice: Plantpal. Happy plants, finally.
- Visuals: Brand logo on the green brand field with the App Store action button.
- Featured Text: Happy plants, finally.

Notes: Test fixture only. No recording starts until the client gives the go.
